title: Answer: yes, free will is the outcome of a quantum operation

statements.text: There is free will. Its outcome is unpredictable even in principle, since quantum probability cannot be read as lack of knowledge, and agency is the outer expression of a self’s free will, with intention and purpose.

sources.quote: its particular outcome is interpreted as the free will

sources.locator: section 'The Properties of the Consciousness Units'
sources.quote: Agency is the outer expression of the free will of a self
